about: Invented text only, and none of the privacy fixture vault's private note names (its `billing` note would refuse the word on its own). `shared` are notes a colleague shares with the reader. `ordinary` is the reader's own writing on the same projects, which nobody shared: it reuses project phrases up to nine words long, or scatters a shared sentence's words across a long paragraph, and must pass. `refused` quotes ten words or more, or rewords one sentence closely, and must be refused.

shared.title: Widget rollout plan
shared.text: We'll send the updated rollout plan to the board on Monday. The pilot covers three regions, and support staffing doubles for the first two weeks. If the vendor misses the audit again, the launch moves to the next quarter and finance rebudgets the marketing spend.

shared.title: Invoicing migration notes
shared.text: The invoicing migration runs over the weekend, starting Friday night after the last invoice batch. Customers on the legacy plan keep their current price until the renewal date. Rollback means restoring the snapshot and replaying the payment queue, which takes about four hours.

shared.title: Interview loop
shared.text: Each candidate meets the hiring manager, two engineers and someone from product. The take-home exercise should take no more than three hours. Feedback goes into the tracker within one business day of the interview.

shared.title: Vendor review findings
shared.text: The vendor review found gaps in access logging and in how backups are encrypted. They promised fixes by the end of the month, but the last two promises slipped. Sam suggested we keep a second vendor warm in case this one fails the audit.
